text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about pedestrian safety on Aldridge Avenue and on surrounding neighbourhood streets. Our office has received a petition from residents in support of the installation of speed humps on Aldridge Avenue. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Aldridge Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and Murdock Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Aldridge Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and Murdock Avenue, generally as shown in Attachment 1 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Brad Bradford.
